methods.captures: electrical resistance between two pins pushed into the material
methods.data: one number on a meter-specific scale (%MC for wood, WME, or a relative 0-100 scale)
methods.cerebro: rule-graded: wood %MC against WOOD_MC_MAX; other scales need a dry reference on the same meter, else U

methods.captures: dielectric response a short depth under the surface
methods.data: relative reading; not comparable across meters or materials
methods.cerebro: rule-graded as U unless compared with a dry reference on the same meter

methods.captures: surface temperature; wet areas can show as cooler patches
methods.data: thermograms and temperature differences; depends on the indoor-outdoor gradient; does not measure moisture content directly
methods.public_labelled_data: no open interior-moisture thermal set found (BFDD IR is exterior)
methods.cerebro: photo grading with the interior_water rubric (image rows); ML not trained

methods.captures: air or in-wall relative humidity and temperature over time
methods.public_labelled_data: Tampere timber-wall lab measurements (CC BY 4.0), not LA high-rise walls
methods.cerebro: rule-graded by interior_water.json (RH rows) and the building water module; no ML forecaster shipped

methods.captures: surface hardness of concrete (rebound number, median of many impacts)
methods.public_labelled_data: Matthews et al. database (CC BY 4.0), paired with core/cube strength
methods.cerebro: ML strength estimate (RN-only power law, or SonReb with UPV) with a 90% interval; calibrate with cores

methods.captures: speed of a sound pulse through concrete; lower speed suggests weaker or cracked concrete
methods.data: velocity Vp (m/s) from path length and transit time; direct, semi-direct or indirect
methods.cerebro: ML strength estimate (Vp-only power law, or SonReb with rebound) with a 90% interval

methods.captures: reflections of radio waves from rebar, voids and moisture below the surface
methods.cerebro: not modelled; record the reading and photos

methods.captures: resonant frequency after a small impact; finds delamination and thickness
hollow sound over delaminated plaster, render or concrete
methods.cerebro: record only (method 'sounding' in the readings template)

methods.captures: spores or surface growth in samples
methods.data: lab counts; EPA says sampling is usually unnecessary when growth is visible and there are no federal limits
methods.cerebro: record only; visible mold is graded from photos by the interior_water rubric
